ordering.1_commitment: this file, committed before L; its git ancestry is the proof that the digest predates the result
ordering.2_backup: an AES-256-GCM envelope of the same bytes pushed off-host to the private artifact repo, indexed in ARTIFACTS.json
ordering.3_reveal: after evaluation, the plaintext secret is published as results/agentic/run_secret_reveal.json and anyone recomputes the digests below to confirm it is the secret this file commits to. NOT the S18 held-out seed reveal (results/agentic/seed_reveal.json), which is a different receipt with its own dedicated commit.

why: The run secret is 32 bytes from os.urandom, created once per run by src/agentlab/suite/contract.py and stored ONLY under gitignored out/. Every recovery token the model sees and every receipt token is derived from it. Losing it makes the receipts unverifiable and the run unresumable; substituting a new one silently changes the model-visible environment. This file fixes the secret's digest in git BEFORE the locks commit, so the secret can be published after the verdict and checked against a commitment that predates the result.
